summary: Two members: the prompt to show, and what happens when the player interacts.
purpose: Lets the detector offer and trigger an interaction without knowing what the thing is. A door, a chest and an NPC answer the same two questions differently.
whenToImplement: On anything the player can interact with. There is no default implementation — unlike damage, which has Health, every interaction is specific.

InteractionPrompt.contract: The text the prompt UI shows, such as "Open" or "Talk". Read whenever this becomes the nearest interactable.
InteractionPrompt.mustNot: Do not do work in the getter. It is read on every scan while the player stands nearby.

Interact(GameObject).contract: Do the thing. Called once per key press, not held. The GameObject passed is the interactor, so a door can check who opened it.
Interact(GameObject).mustNot: Do not assume it only happens once. Nothing stops the player interacting with the same object repeatedly — an already-open chest must handle being opened again.

calledBy: InteractionDetector, which reads the prompt while this is the nearest candidate and calls Interact on the key press. Nothing else.
useCases: Pickups that do something more than being collected.
A context-sensitive prompt whose text changes with state.

gotchas.title: A changing prompt is read live
gotchas.body: Returning "Open" or "Locked" depending on state works, because it is read each scan rather than cached.
